title: Contract amendment body
description: An amendment of a contract's scope by consent (register row JO5; spec-delta S1701): one party signs it and the other cosigns (amendment_not_a_party, amendment_needs_consent). It changes the purpose or the acceptance criteria, never the price, the deadline or the parties: those are a new contract, and the deadline in particular is the one the lifecycle's delivered_in_time guard reads. It is made before delivery (amendment_too_late), at most three times for a contract (amendment_limit), and the terms in force are the contract's with each amendment applied in order. Subject: the contract. Chain: none (prev is null).
